notes: Registry spans are used because the abstracts do not report atrial fibrillation. Served counts and time frame match. The source labels 1.23 a Rate Ratio; RR here preserves that meaning, rather than asserting a reported risk ratio. The factorial comparison pools aspirin and placebo-aspirin assignments in each omega-3 group.
